fee_notes: Royalty tiered: 6% on monthly GR up to $83,300, 5% on GR above $83,300; min $500/mo months 7-12, $1,500/mo thereafter, no minimum first 6 months. Marketing fund capped at 3% GR; min may increase with CPI. Tech fee $650/mo first territory, $200/mo each additional. Local Advertising Services Program Fee: $3,000/mo first 6 months, $2,500/mo thereafter (franchisor retains greater of $300 or 10% as management fee).
raw_excerpt: Royalty: You must pay the greater of: (a) 6.0% - 5.0% of your Gross Revenue for the immediately preceding month or (b) $500 per month per territory for the second six months and $1,500 per month per territory thereafter. Technology Fee: Currently $650 per month per territory for the first territory, $200 for second and subsequent territories.
